key_insight: ProCARE turns real-world study automation into a constrained compilation problem by grounding LLM agents in dataset-specific evidence contracts and a typed intermediate representation.
clinical_relevance: This could make AI-generated observational research workflows more reliable for treatment effects, safety monitoring, and risk-factor studies using EHR or claims data.
method: Converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts with variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits.
Compiles study goals into RWS-IR, a strongly typed format for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks.
Uses deterministic validation and localized repair to catch and fix schema, cohort, analysis, and interpretation errors.
evidence_signal: On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE improved code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability versus strong LLM-agent baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and completeness of dataset profiling, and the approach still needs careful human oversight for unsupported clinical claims.
paper_title: ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts
